{"requirements": [
{"id": 1, "text": "The program shall allow the user to complete 33 levels successfully."},
{"id": 2, "text": "The program shall display a board that is 200 pixels wide horizontally and 300 pixels wide vertically."},
{"id": 3, "text": "The program shall render bricks and the paddle as rectangular blocks with a width of 20 pixels and height of 10 pixels. The program shall render the ball as a circle with a diameter of 10 pixels."},
{"id": 4, "text": "At the beginning of each level, the program shall start the ball from the top left corner of the board and move it downwards with a straight trajectory at a 45° angle and a speed of 5 pixels per second."},
{"id": 5, "text": "The user shall be able to move the paddle in order to hit the ball, making it change its direction upward."},
{"id": 6, "text": "The user shall successfully complete a level by breaking all bricks."},
{"id": 7, "text": "Bricks shall have a color (blue, red, gold) and can be sized single or double."},
{"id": 8, "text": "A brick shall be sized single (20 x 10 pixels) or double (60 x 10 pixels)."},
{"id": 9, "text": "Blue bricks shall be destroyed with one hit, red bricks shall require two hits, and gold bricks shall require three hits."},
{"id": 10, "text": "The first level shall be initialized with 50 blue, single bricks that are placed in the brick section of the board."},
{"id": 11, "text": "The paddle shall only move horizontally on the bottom of the board, controlled by the user using the left and right arrow keys. The paddle shall not be able to go outside the board. When each level starts, the paddle shall reset to the center of the bottom border."},
{"id": 12, "text": "The ball direction shall change every time the ball hits the paddle or the border of the board (except for the bottom border) with the correct angle of reflection."},
{"id": 13, "text": "Every time the next level starts, the program shall increase the speed of the ball by a sufficient amount."},
{"id": 14, "text": "When the user finishes a level, the program shall start the next level with a different brick arrangement and increased difficulty. Each level shall remove two red bricks and one gold brick."},
{"id": 15, "text": "The program shall randomly generate the brick pattern and arrangement."},
{"id": 16, "text": "The program shall give the user 3 lives."},
{"id": 17, "text": "The user shall lose a life every time the ball falls off the side of the board."},
{"id": 18, "text": "When the user loses a life but still has lives remaining, the program shall restart the level if possible. Once the user loses all lives, the game shall be over."},
{"id": 19, "text": "When the game is over, the program shall allow the user to start again from level 1 or end the game."}
]}
